market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver's all-time high is ~$50/oz. Reaching $120 in 15 months (from ~$34) requires a 3.5x gain, exceeding historical extremes even during volatile periods like 1980 and 2011. Without hyperinflation or a catastrophic supply collapse, this outcome is exceedingly improbable. Thus the true probability is <1%, far below the 6.8% implied by the market.
evidence_points: Silver never traded above $50; $120 is more than double the all-time high.
Current front-month silver is ~$34, requiring a ~250% increase in about 15 months.
Implied volatility of ~30% annualized suggests a 3.5x move is a >6-sigma event.
sources_consulted: Economic forecasts for inflation and industrial demand
